summary: Iteration 2 — verified the 4 new features (spec levels, combined lab-wide trend, peer benchmark, branded report) plus regression on core CRUD/CSV. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed including new test_analyte_specs_structure_and_tibc_math (TIBC CVI 6.4 -> optimal.cv 1.6, desirable.cv 3.2, minimum.cv 4.8; backward-compat flat fields match specs.desirable) and test_peer_sigma_range (all 47 analytes clamped 1.5-7.0). Frontend: Database level toggle switches CV/Bias/TEa columns (TIBC TEa optimal 4.01 < desirable 8.02 < minimum 12.03); Peer σ column visible (Glucose 3.8); Use button on Glucose prefilled Calculator TEa=3.48 when optimal, 10.44 when minimum — confirms currently-selected level. Peer-Benchmark card renders your/median/delta (Glucose your 6.67, median 3.8, delta +2.87σ) and correctly shows prompt for custom analyte 'MyCustomAnalyte_XYZ'. Combined trend card renders 10 lines with legend (10 items). Branding dialog saves lab name/address/director/accreditation to localStorage and letterhead ('TEST Central Lab', 'Sigma City') + signature ('Dr. TestDirector') update. CSV export downloaded 'sigmalab-qc-report-2026-09-10.csv'.

issues: Logo (default hexagon 'σ') and lab name render on the same baseline visually acceptable; when lab name is very long letterhead does not wrap, minor cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: SigmaCalculator: 'Select is changing from uncontrolled to controlled' warning fires when analyte name is cleared/switched — set default to '' instead of undefined in the Select value prop to silence.

LabRecordsManager: multiple 'ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1)' recharts warnings on initial mount (transient before layout) — non-blocking, but could be reduced by giving the container a fixed min-height on first paint.
Radix DialogContent for record-edit-dialog missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby — a11y warning in console.
ReportExporter localStorage-only branding is intentional per spec; consider gating logo dataURL size stricter (>500KB) to reduce localStorage bloat.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (carry-over from iter1).
seed_data_creation: Backend already seeded 40 records. Test created TEST_ prefixed records and cleaned up. Frontend test wrote a lab profile to localStorage under key 'sigmalab_lab_profile' (test values, safe to leave).
